final: WITH media_averages AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS average_price FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_price) AS overall_average FROM media_averages) SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.average_price, m.average_price / o.overall_average AS price_ratio FROM media_averages AS m CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.overall_average IS NOT NULL ORDER BY price_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
